assessments.reasoning: The accessible mirror carries ISO/IEC 7185:1990(E) identification, clause structure, and edition content. Edition and title were checked against the IEC publication record. Fresh capture digest aaef1d686020d7bea96de8ce77f21ee9715c37a3c9d412ec998768aff80c82f6 binds the full inspected response. The controlling passage is §6.1.3 Identifiers, printed page 7 / PDF page 13. ISO/IEC 7185:1990 requires Pascal identifier spelling to disregard letter case and bars identifiers with the spelling of a word-symbol. This applies to identifiers in programs governed by ISO/IEC 7185:1990. The rule concerns identifier spelling, independent of case in the contents of character strings or extensions in later dialects. The neighboring clause expressly distinguishes characters inside character strings.
